Gear describes energy; crash describes a specific audible musical event. A crash requires a clear planned drop within the actual source-song arrangement, verified by listening through that interval. Until verified, use energy reduction/transition. If no deliberate drop exists and the story needs a crash, choose a source song with a real drop; never invent or certify an unverified event.
